quotes.quote: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS
Procurement/MinuteTraq #: 54009
Date to be opened: 7/27/2026

The City of Providence Department of Public Works, Parking Administration Division, seeks competitive bids from qualified manufacturers and distributors for the furnishing and delivery of parking regulatory signs, parking sign posts, mounting hardware, parking control devices, and related materials on an as-needed basis under a firm fixed unit price requirements contract.
This solicitation will result in a Firm Fixed Unit Price, Blanket Requirements, Estimated Quantity Contract.

Award shall be made to the lowest responsive and responsible bidder based on the aggregate evaluated price and the bidder's demonstrated responsibility, delivery capability, product quality, warranty, references, and compliance with the specifications.
Bids may be submitted up to 2:15 P.M. on the above meeting date at the Department of the City Clerk.

This ordinance outlines requirements for hiring Providence residents to work on this project. The City may waive this requirement only upon a determination in writing that qualified residents of Providence are not available for the project, pursuant to Sec. 21-94(e). The attention of prospective bidders is called to the fact that reporting the efforts undertaken and progress towards achieving the requirements in this ordinance is a condition for payment.

findings.title: Financial Assurance Requirements
findings.fact: The bid form indicates that financial assurances may be required. The specific type (certified check, bid bond, performance bond) is not specified in the provided pages; the checkboxes are blank.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be prepared to provide the required financial assurance, which could be a bid bond or performance bond, affecting bid costs.
findings.action_recommendation: Clarify with the City which financial assurance is required for this solicitation.

quotes.quote: Financial assurances may be required in order to be a successful bidder for Commodity or Construction and Service contracts. If either of the first two checkboxes below is checked, the specified assurance must accompany a bid, or the bid will not be considered by the Board of Contract and Supply. The third checkbox indicates the lowest responsible bidder will be contacted and required to post a bond to be awarded the contract.

findings.title: Public Disclosure of Bid Information
findings.fact: All bids become public record upon receipt and opening. Bidders are warned not to include sensitive information unless requested, as the City has no obligation to redact it.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be cautious not to include confidential or proprietary information in the bid, as it will be publicly disclosed.
findings.action_recommendation: Review bid documents to ensure no sensitive information is included unless specifically requested.

quotes.quote: All bids submitted in response to Requests for Proposals (RFP’s) and Requests for Qualification (RFQ’s), documents contained within, and the details outlined on those documents become public record upon receipt by the City Clerk’s office and opening at the corresponding Board of Contract and Supply (BOCS) meeting.

If sensitive information that has not been requested is enclosed or if a bidder opts to enclose the defined supplemental information prior to the issuing department’s request in the bidding packet submitted to the City Clerk, the City of Providence has no obligation to redact those details and bears no liability associated with the information becoming public record.
